scientific_integrity: The weak-plus-first-moment characterization of W_1 and the perspective cancellation identities are prior tools and are not claimed as new. The claim is restricted to the exact nonzero boundary transport defect and its positive/negative call-put decomposition under the stated change-of-numeraire assumptions.
scientific_limitations: First-order asymptotic statement only: no finite-n rate, no W_s additive-defect formula for s>1, and no conclusion when primitive numeraire or payoff uniform integrability fails.
title: Exact boundary transport defect for change-of-numeraire reweighting
